paragraphs.source_en: From the twenty-sixth day of the seventh month to the first day of the eighth month in the nineteenth year of Keichō, Katagiri Katsumoto remained in Osaka Castle as if seated on a bed of needles. As soon as the first day of the eighth month arrived, he hurried out of the castle and made straight for Kyoto. Still not a word had come from Sunpu. He therefore assumed that Ieyasu had accepted his proposal and agreed to postpone the matter of transferring the fief until after the sixteenth anniversary of the Taikō's death.

units.source_en: From the twenty-sixth day of the seventh month to the first day of the eighth month in the nineteenth year of Keichō, Katagiri Katsumoto remained in Osaka Castle as if seated on a bed of needles.
units.source_zh: 从庆长十九年七月二十六到八月初一，片桐且元待在大坂城内，如坐针毡。

units.source_en: As soon as the first day of the eighth month arrived, he hurried out of the castle and made straight for Kyoto.
units.source_zh: 一到八月初一，他就速速出城，直奔京都而去。

units.source_en: Still not a word had come from Sunpu.
units.source_zh: 骏府那边依然无半点音信。

units.source_en: He therefore assumed that Ieyasu had accepted his proposal and agreed to postpone the matter of transferring the fief until after the sixteenth anniversary of the Taikō's death.
units.source_zh: 因此，他以为家康已接受了他的建议，答应暂且把移封之事拖到太阁十六年忌之后。

paragraphs.source_zh: 从庆长十九年七月二十六到八月初一，片桐且元待在大坂城内，如坐针毡。一到八月初一，他就速速出城，直奔京都而去。骏府那边依然无半点音信。因此，他以为家康已接受了他的建议，答应暂且把移封之事拖到太阁十六年忌之后。

paragraphs.source_en: The consecration had been fixed for the third day of the eighth month, only two days away. The shoshidai must have reported every detail of the situation in Kyoto to Sunpu; since Lord Ieyasu had issued no further instructions to Katsumoto, it meant that he had accepted the proposal. Thus Katagiri Katsumoto, then traveling to Kyoto aboard a Chaya boat, naturally felt a weight lift from his mind.

units.source_en: The consecration had been fixed for the third day of the eighth month, only two days away.
units.source_zh: 开光的日子定于八月初三，只差两天了。

units.source_en: The shoshidai must have reported every detail of the situation in Kyoto to Sunpu; since Lord Ieyasu had issued no further instructions to Katsumoto, it meant that he had accepted the proposal.

れたということだった。

units.source_en: Thus Katagiri Katsumoto, then traveling to Kyoto aboard a Chaya boat, naturally felt a weight lift from his mind.
units.source_zh: 因此，此时乘坐茶屋船赶赴京都的片桐且元，自是松了一口气。

paragraphs.source_zh: 开光的日子定于八月初三，只差两天了。京都的情形一定都由所司代一一禀告骏府，既然家康公未另向且元作任何吩咐，就说明已接受了他的建议。因此，此时乘坐茶屋船赶赴京都的片桐且元，自是松了一口气。

paragraphs.source_en: When the boat reached Fushimi, Katsumoto was astounded. It had been on the twenty-fifth day of the seventh month that he had shown the new temple bell to Itakura Katsushige and Hon'ami Kōetsu. There had already been many people around Higashiyama then, but he had never imagined that the whole stretch from Fushimi to Kyoto would now be virtually lost beneath a sea of humanity. Viewing stands lined both sides of the highway to Higashiyama; curtains had been raised everywhere, and dazzling scarlet gauze and felt were spread all about.

units.source_en: When the boat reached Fushimi, Katsumoto was astounded.
units.source_zh: 船一到伏见，且元就惊呆了。

units.source_en: It had been on the twenty-fifth day of the seventh month that he had shown the new temple bell to Itakura Katsushige and Hon'ami Kōetsu.

units.source_en: There had already been many people around Higashiyama then, but he had never imagined that the whole stretch from Fushimi to Kyoto would now be virtually lost beneath a sea of humanity.
units.source_zh: 虽然那时东山一带人已很多，他万未料到，从伏见到京都一带，现在几已是人山人海。

paragraphs.source_en: Higashiyama itself was even more densely packed, with a particularly large number of richly dressed women.

units.source_en: Higashiyama itself was even more densely packed, with a particularly large number of richly dressed women.

paragraphs.source_en: “Good heavens, the consecration has not even begun. Why are there already so many people?” Katsumoto asked a passerby.

units.source_en: “Good heavens, the consecration has not even begun. Why are there already so many people?”

units.source_en: Katsumoto asked a passerby.

paragraphs.source_zh: “喂喂，开光仪式还没开始呢，怎的人就这般多了？”且元向路人询问。

paragraphs.source_en: “With things arranged like this, the crowds on the third will be crushing, and the womenfolk naturally won't be able to see a thing. That is why everyone has been coming out to worship from today onward.”

paragraphs.source_zh: “照这种安排，初三还不挤死人，女人家自然就看不到了。因此，从今日起大家就都出来参拜了。”

paragraphs.source_en: Katsumoto then understood: foreseeing unbearable congestion on the day of the ceremony, people had come to see it in advance. No wonder there were so many women.

units.source_en: Katsumoto then understood: foreseeing unbearable congestion on the day of the ceremony, people had come to see it in advance. No wonder there were so many women.

paragraphs.source_en: Through the tumultuous crowd there passed one noisy procession of monks after another, all of them clerics from various regions who had gathered in Kyoto to attend the ceremony three days later.

units.source_en: Through the tumultuous crowd there passed one noisy procession of monks after another, all of them clerics from various regions who had gathered in Kyoto to attend the ceremony three days later.
units.source_zh: 在杂乱的人群中，不断有吹吹打打的僧侣队列通过，全都是为列席三日后的典礼而汇集京都的各地僧侣。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在杂乱的人群中，不断有吹吹打打的僧侣队列通过，全都是为列席三日后的典礼而汇集京都的各地僧侣。

paragraphs.source_en: People tossed sake-scented paper lotus blossoms into the passing processions, and the atmosphere at once grew festive.

units.source_en: People tossed sake-scented paper lotus blossoms into the passing processions, and the atmosphere at once grew festive.
units.source_zh: 人们把充满酒气的纸莲花抛洒在行进的队伍中，气氛顿时热烈起来。

paragraphs.source_en: Jostled amid the crowd, Katagiri Katsumoto felt his eyes grow hot several times. These people, too, were so full of joy because they knew that war would not break out. He did not yet know that his dream had long since been shattered.

units.source_en: Jostled amid the crowd, Katagiri Katsumoto felt his eyes grow hot several times.
units.source_zh: 在人群中拥挤，有好几次，片桐且元眼角都热了。

units.source_en: These people, too, were so full of joy because they knew that war would not break out.
units.source_zh: 这些人也知战争不会打起来，才充满喜悦之情。

units.source_en: He did not yet know that his dream had long since been shattered.

paragraphs.source_zh: 在人群中拥挤，有好几次，片桐且元眼角都热了。这些人也知战争不会打起来，才充满喜悦之情。此时的他还不知，他的梦早已被击碎。

paragraphs.source_en: That night, Katsumoto had festive bonfires lit before the Great Buddha Hall of Hōkō-ji to heighten the mood.

paragraphs.source_en: It was the following day—the second day of the eighth month—that Katagiri Katsumoto received the order to “postpone” from the shoshidai, Itakura Katsushige.

units.source_en: It was the following day—the second day of the eighth month—that Katagiri Katsumoto received the order to “postpone” from the shoshidai, Itakura Katsushige.
units.source_zh: 片桐且元从所司代板仓胜重处得到“延期”之令，为第二日，即八月初二。

paragraphs.source_zh: 片桐且元从所司代板仓胜重处得到“延期”之令，为第二日，即八月初二。

paragraphs.source_en: On the second day of the eighth month, the festivities were several times livelier than the day before. From early morning, magnificently attired women arrived in an unbroken stream, their sumptuous dress calling to mind the Pure Land of Perfect Bliss.

units.source_en: On the second day of the eighth month, the festivities were several times livelier than the day before.
units.source_zh: 八月初二，气氛比前一日热闹了数倍。

units.source_en: From early morning, magnificently attired women arrived in an unbroken stream, their sumptuous dress calling to mind the Pure Land of Perfect Bliss.
units.source_zh: 从清晨起，身着盛装的女子就络绎不绝，装束的华美，让人想到了极乐净土。

paragraphs.source_zh: 八月初二，气氛比前一日热闹了数倍。从清晨起，身着盛装的女子就络绎不绝，装束的华美，让人想到了极乐净土。

paragraphs.source_en: The Daigo cherry-blossom viewing held while the Taikō was alive had left people speechless with wonder, but those who wore splendid garments then had all been the Taikō's wives and concubines or the ladies of the great daimyō. Yet today, seventeen years later, those sumptuous colors had become a radiance flowing forth from the streets of the common people. How wonderful peace was!

paragraphs.source_en: Gazing at the lively scene before him and recalling the Taikō's bygone days, Katsumoto passed through the temple gate without realizing it.

units.source_en: Gazing at the lively scene before him and recalling the Taikō's bygone days, Katsumoto passed through the temple gate without realizing it.
units.source_zh: 且元望着眼前的热闹情景，遥想太阁旧事，不觉间出了山门。

paragraphs.source_zh: 且元望着眼前的热闹情景，遥想太阁旧事，不觉间出了山门。

paragraphs.source_en: For more than a dozen chō around the approach to the temple stood countless stalls and shops; merchants from near and far and performing mountebanks alike shouted themselves hoarse to attract customers. The joy of the common people before him was the fruit of his own labors, and Katsumoto felt deeply comforted.

units.source_en: For more than a dozen chō around the approach to the temple stood countless stalls and shops; merchants from near and far and performing mountebanks alike shouted themselves hoarse to attract customers.

paragraphs.source_en: Indeed, the bond between the Great Buddha Hall and the Toyotomi clan ran deep.

units.source_en: Indeed, the bond between the Great Buddha Hall and the Toyotomi clan ran deep.
units.source_zh: 说来，大佛殿与丰臣氏的缘分真是不浅。

paragraphs.source_zh: 说来，大佛殿与丰臣氏的缘分真是不浅。

paragraphs.source_en: It embodied the devotion of two generations of Toyotomi, father and son. Now that the Buddhist hall stood in all its grandeur, Hideyori and Lady Yodo must both be immersed in boundless emotion.

units.source_en: It embodied the devotion of two generations of Toyotomi, father and son.

units.source_en: Now that the Buddhist hall stood in all its grandeur, Hideyori and Lady Yodo must both be immersed in boundless emotion.
units.source_zh: 既然佛殿已经雄伟地屹立起来，秀赖和淀夫人必都沉浸于无限感慨。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此乃丰臣父子两代的执著。既然佛殿已经雄伟地屹立起来，秀赖和淀夫人必都沉浸于无限感慨。

paragraphs.source_en: Katsumoto had walked two or three chō along the shop-lined avenue, looking about as he went, when his second son, Tamemoto, who had accompanied him to Kyoto, suddenly called to him: “Father, the shoshidai has sent an urgent messenger.”

units.source_en: Katsumoto had walked two or three chō along the shop-lined avenue, looking about as he went, when his second son, Tamemoto, who had accompanied him to Kyoto, suddenly called to him: “Father, the shoshidai has sent an urgent messenger.”
units.source_zh: 且元沿着店铺林立的大道边走边看，走了两三町，忽地被随他来京的次子为元叫住：“父亲大人，所司代十万火急派人来。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 且元沿着店铺林立的大道边走边看，走了两三町，忽地被随他来京的次子为元叫住：“父亲大人，所司代十万火急派人来。”

paragraphs.source_en: Startled, Katsumoto turned around. “It must be about tomorrow's ceremony. Who has come?”

paragraphs.source_en: “It is...” Tamemoto faltered. “Someone who appears to have come to announce a postponement...”

paragraphs.source_en: “A postponement?” Katsumoto heard a roar inside his head; at once his blood rushed upward and darkness closed over his eyes. He desperately forced his way through the crowd, with no awareness even of how he removed his shoes and climbed into the reception hall beside the new temple.

paragraphs.source_en: “I see.” Nakabō Sakon Hidemasa considered for a moment. “Then, Lord Ichinoshō, you mean to assume responsibility alone so that tomorrow's memorial service may proceed as planned?”

paragraphs.source_en: “Precisely! If blame comes afterward, I, Katsumoto, shall atone by committing seppuku.”
